publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Review-only scientific algorithmic anatomical or pathology reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, patient record, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: NLM MeSH supplies controlled condition identity and scope; official NIH sources supply conservative anatomical and communication boundaries only. No source image or design is copied.

reviewStandard: Current controlled condition identity, anatomically conservative and non-diagnostic representation, non-stigmatizing communication, complete pale edge field, crop-safe geometry, and exact prompt must be frozen before exactly one generation call per cleared route. Observed output controls later metadata.
promotionRule: No output may receive a registry key, public master, derivative, endpoint, schema node, or sitemap entry before immutable native-resolution review and exact-hash Control Tower acceptance.

assets.representationBoundary: Complete paired-kidney orientation with one restrained nephron and glomerular inset; no universal gross lesion, stage, dialysis, etiology, severity, laboratory value, or diagnosis.
Complete liver teaching model with one limited cutaway showing representative fibrous septa around regenerative nodules; no asserted cause, stage, complication, patient, or diagnosis.
Complete colon and rectum teaching model with one restrained raised mucosal lesion visible through a small cutaway; no stage, metastasis, obstruction, procedure, patient, or diagnosis.

Complete heart and coronary-vessel orientation with a separate representative artery cross-section containing eccentric plaque and a patent lumen; no occlusion, infarction, clot, stage, symptoms, procedure, or diagnosis.

Complete terminal ileum, cecum, and colon orientation with one separate bowel-wall model showing patchy transmural inflammation; no fistula, obstruction, bleeding, distribution claim, severity, patient, or diagnosis.

Neutral multisystem exocrine orientation with complete lungs, one airway cross-section, and a separate complete pancreas; no person, infection organism, genotype, stage, treatment, universal severity, or diagnosis.
